 Alan Ritchson's violent, fast-paced action thriller is getting a major new release in 2027. In so many ways, 2026 was the year that confirmed Alan Ritchson is the new reigning action star.

 Ritchson's sci-fi actioner War Machine was one of Netflix's biggest hits in 2026, and the start of a planned franchise. While his action throwback Runner (not to be confused with Gal Gadot's THE Runner ) underperformed at the box office, it was a comfortable streaming success. Reacher season four was another smash for Amazon, as was the spinoff Neagley , where Ritchson made a couple of guest appearances.
 While War Machine was the most successful, Ritchson's best action movie of 2026 was Motor City . This 1970s set thriller sees Ritchson's ex-con seeking revenge against a gangster after a long prison stint. Aside from its fantastic action, the big hook of Motor City was that it barely featured any dialogue .
 Alan Ritchson's Motor City Is Getting A Blu-Ray Release In 2027
 Motor City is a screenplay that took a circular path to the big screen. It landed on the 2009 Black List - an industry survey of the "most liked" unproduced scripts of a given year - and soon attracted names like Gerard Butler and Chris Evans. The project eventually lost steam, however, only for Alan Ritchson himself to resurrect it as star and producer many years later.
 Sadly, Motor Cit y was a major box office disappointment, grossing about a tenth of its $30 million production budget (via Box Office Mojo ), despite earning positive reviews. Like Runner , the movie found a second life on streaming platforms like AMC+ and Philo, and it has now been confirmed that Motor City will get a Blu-ray release on January 12, 2027 . 
 Fans hoping for an Alan Ritchson commentary or elaborate bonus features are out of luck, however - there are currently no extras listed for the Motor City Blu-ray. Still, the movie's release on physical media at all is welcome news for those who loved it in theaters.
 Alan Ritchson Is A Throwback Action Movie Star, And Motor City Confirms It
 Alan Ritchson as John Miller standing in front of bars with a tense expression on his face in Motor City. 
 After years of killing it with Reacher , 2026 saw Ritchson diving headfirst into movies. As a star, Ritchson is a throwback to the glory days of action icons like Sylvester Stallone or Arnold Schwarzenegger, and Motor City feels like sometjing Arnie or Sly could have fronted in their heydays. It's an old-school, practical action film with a unique hook and one that earns its R-rating with gusto.
 One key element that made movies like Predator or First Blood linger with generations of action devotees is how rewatchable they are. From TV viewings all the way up to collectable 4K re-releases, these are films audiences keep coming back to. While much of Ritchson's output is streaming only ( Playdate , War Machine , etc.), Motor City earning a Blu-ray release underlines Ritchson's throwback status.
 This is a film that will find its fanbase in the years ahead, and one that rewards multiple viewings. In short, it's a film any self-respecting Alan Ritchson fan will want on their Blu-ray shelf.
 If You Like Alan Ritchson, Motor City Is A Must Watch
 Alan Ritchson at the premiere of Motor City Credit: mpi099/MediaPunch/INSTARimages 
 More than being an actioner, Motor City works as a moving drama. At its core, it's a tragic romance, and it's all the more impressive for its near-total lack of dialogue. Ritchson might be built like a tank, but he is also an emotive performer, and the silent nature of the story really lets him show off his acting muscles too. Plus, he is backed up with great supporting turns by Ben Foster and Shailene Woodley.
 Motor City also looks incredible, with beautiful cinematography and production design. It appears the dearth of dialogue turned some viewers off, which is a real shame, since it is a very pure example of that old adage " Show, don't tell. " Again, it's the best movie Alan Ritchson starred in during 2026 and is practically guaranteed to be a cult classic.
